en: Color postcard showing a modernist hotel complex with the sign HOTEL BRAN, lawns and sculptures in front, under a blue sky. The back has Romanian pre-printed address fields, handwritten note, Romanian stamps (including a JUDETUL BUZAU coat-of-arms 55 b stamp and a 40 b POSTA ROMANA stamp) and Bucuresti postmarks. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the view as Eforie Nord: Hotelul «Bran».
